title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
What you’ll do

● Review requirements, user stories, and designs; identify gaps, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

● Plan and perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.

● Build and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys across web and mobile.

● Test APIs and backend workflows, including request validation, responses, error handling, and data consistency.

● Test Salesforce features and workflows, including record creation and updates, permissions, automation, reports, and integrations.

● Validate end-to-end scenarios such as registration, profile and credential updates, job search, applications, recruiter interactions, and status changes.

● Verify data flows between the product, Salesforce, and connected services; investigate sync failures and duplicate or missing records.

● Track test cases, defects, and QA work in Jira; write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.

● Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and improve testability.

● Maintain test plans, test cases, automation suites, and release quality notes.

● Participate in release readiness reviews and help the team make risk-based testing decisions.

● Consider accessibility, usability, privacy, and security in day-to-day testing.

What you’ll bring

● 3+ years of experience in software QA, including both manual and automation testing.

● Experience testing web applications and REST APIs.

● Hands-on experience with an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

● Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.

● Salesforce testing experience, ideally with Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.

● Understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, profiles and permissions, Flows, reports, and integration behavior.

● Practical experience using Jira to manage defects, test work, and project workflows.

● Ability to write clear test scenarios and communicate defects with useful steps, expected results, and actual results.

● Familiarity with SQL or another method of validating application data.

● Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile practices, and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize testing based on user and business impact.

Good to have

● Experience testing mobile applications or responsive web experiences.

● Experience with healthcare, recruiting, staffing, or job marketplace products.

● Familiarity with AI-enabled features, including conversational search and recommendations.

● Experience with Salesforce integration testing, such as REST APIs, middleware, or event-driven data flows.

● Familiarity with accessibility and cross-browser testing.

Pay: ₹289,000.00 - ₹1,020,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

description:

**Company:** ModelsLab  
**Experience:** 0–1 Years  
**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, Work From Office

About ModelsLab & MStudio.ai

ModelsLab develops innovative AI and SaaS products. Our flagship product, **MStudio.ai**, is an AI filmmaking platform that brings scriptwriting, character creation, image generation, video generation, voice, and timeline-based editing into one creative workspace.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Backend Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to building, maintaining, and improving the backend infrastructure of MStudio.ai and other ModelsLab products.

Fresh graduates with good programming fundamentals and practical projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain backend applications and server-side functionality.
* Build, integrate, and maintain REST APIs.
* Work on backend features for MStudio.ai.
* Manage databases, queries, and data structures.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Debug issues, fix bugs, and improve application performance.
* Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
* Collaborate with frontend developers and other engineering teams.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Test backend functionality and ensure application reliability.
* Maintain technical documentation.

Required Skills

* 0–1 years of experience in Backend Development.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical knowledge.
* Good understanding of PHP and backend programming fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of Laravel or similar backend frameworks.
* Understanding of MySQL and relational databases.
* Knowledge of REST APIs and JSON.
* Basic understanding of Git and version control.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Good debugging and problem-solving skills.

Additional Advantage

* Knowledge of React Native integration.
* Familiarity with Node.js or other backend technologies.
* Understanding of authentication and API security.
* Knowledge of Linux, server deployment, and cloud environments.
* Experience with personal or academic backend development projects.

Ideal Candidate

Someone with strong programming fundamentals, a willingness to learn, attention to detail, and an interest in building scalable backend systems for real-world technology products.

**Freshers with practical projects and good coding fundamentals are encouraged to apply.**

**Apply:** hr@modelslab.com

title: Dot Net Intern
description:
We are seeking a motivated .NET Intern to join our dynamic team for a 6-month internship. This role is designed to provide hands-on experience in .NET development and is ideal for individuals who have foundational knowledge of .NET MVC and are eager to learn more. Upon successful completion of the internship, high-performing interns may be offered a full-time position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Collaborate with the development team to design, develop, test, and deploy web applications using .NET MVC framework.

Assist in writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

Participate in code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting issues.

Gain exposure to various stages of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Support the team in documenting and maintaining technical specifications.

Work closely with senior developers to implement new features and optimize existing ones.  
Contribute to team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and collaborative projects.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

Education: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Computer Science, Information Technology, or related degree program.

Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of .NET MVC, .NET Core, C#, and object-oriented programming.

Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL is a plus.

Problem-Solving: Ability to understand and troubleshoot basic coding issues.  
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Team Player: Willingness to collaborate and take guidance from experienced team members.

Adaptability: Open to learning new technologies and adapting to a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Hands-on experience with .NET MVC & .NET Core projects (academic or personal projects are acceptable).

Basic knowledge of web development frameworks and RESTful APIs.

Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.

Understanding of front-end frameworks like Bootstrap or jQuery.

**Benefits of the Internship:**

Practical Experience: Opportunity to work on real-world projects.

Learning and Development: Mentorship from experienced developers and access to learning resources.

Networking: Connect with industry professionals and build a strong professional network.

Potential Job Offer: Successful interns may be considered for a full-time role based on performance.

Perigeon Software is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are a forward-thinking company dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that help our clients succeed. As part of our team, you will be exposed to cutting-edge technologies, industry best practices, and a collaborative work culture.

title: Associate – Java
description:
Gandhinagar Full-time 4-5 yrs

  

* Experience4–5 years
* LocationGIFT City, Gandhinagar
* QualificationB.Tech or B.E., B.C.A. prior to M.C.A.
* Shift10:00 AM to 6:30 PM

**Role Overview**
-----------------

**Mid-Level Java Backend Engineer.** We are seeking a Java Backend Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support enterprise backend services for identity, authentication, user-profile, session, and OTP-based workflows. The role involves working on business-critical REST APIs, secure authentication flows, database operations, messaging integrations, and production deployments on JBoss/WildFly.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain Java-based REST APIs for user registration, authentication, profile management, password updates, session handling, and administrative operations.
* Build and support secure authentication mechanisms including JWT, API credentials, OTP/MFA flows, token validation, token refresh, and logout.
* Develop and maintain OTP generation, verification, expiry, retry/failed-attempt, and notification-delivery workflows.
* Write and optimize SQL queries and JDBC-based data-access components for MySQL databases.
* Integrate backend services with Apache Kafka and external HTTP-based enterprise systems.
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot WAR applications on JBoss/WildFly.
* Manage application-server concerns including JNDI datasource configuration, deployment setup, logs, runtime configuration, and release support.
* Investigate production issues using application/server logs, request IDs, database records, Kafka messages, and API traces.
* Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and improve code quality and reliability.
* Create and maintain API documentation, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Follow secure coding practices while handling customer identity, authentication, and sensitive data.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 4–5 years of hands-on Java backend development experience.
* Strong core Java knowledge, including collections, exception handling, concurrency fundamentals, streams, and secure coding practices.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs using JAX-RS, Jersey, RESTEasy, Spring Boot, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Java EE/Jakarta EE concepts, including CDI, EJB, Servlets, JAX-RS, and WAR deployments.
* Hands-on experience deploying and supporting applications on JBoss/WildFly or similar Java application servers.
